title: Feat/registry video duration fields
author: fisventurous
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds minimum, maximum, and default duration metadata for all video models.
- Represents discrete durations for Veo and Wan and stepped durations for Nova Reel.
- Exposes the fields through `/models`, `/image/models`, `/video/models`, and SDK types.
- Adds focused registry coverage for video and non-video models.

Fixes #13655

gist.headline: Videos learn to count
gist.blurb: The video garden got little duration markers. Models can now say how long their movies like to be, before anyone starts rendering clouds for 47 seconds by accident.
gist.summary: Added minimum, maximum, and default duration metadata for every video model, including discrete duration options for Veo and Wan and stepped durations for Nova Reel, exposed through the model endpoints and SDK types.
gist.impact: Apps and developers can now read supported video lengths from `/models`, `/image/models`, and `/video/models` to present valid duration controls and select sensible defaults.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy video-model garden where duration settings grow as labeled timeline flowers: separate stepping stones for Veo and Wan's discrete choices, plus a gently graduated ruler-vine for Nova Reel's stepped durations. Polli, wearing a tiny film director beret and holding a clipboard, checks the timeline plants beside a friendly CRT monitor robot displaying a short pixel film strip.
